question: List Renal cell trials requiring a biomarker other than PD‑L1 for inclusion.

gemini.answer: This SQL query selects trials related to renal cell carcinoma (RCC) where inclusion criteria involved biomarkers other than PD-L1.
gemini.raw: {"sql":"SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"other_biomarker_inclusion\", \"cancer_type\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" = 'RCC' AND \"other_biomarker_inclusion\" ILIKE '%Yes%';","answer":"This SQL query selects trials related to renal cell carcinoma (RCC) where inclusion criteria involved biomarkers other than PD-L1.","assumptions":""}
